header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: اَرْبَعِيْنَ اَلْفًا، فَجَاءَهُ مَالٌ فَدَفَعَهُ اِلَيَّ وَقَالَ: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ فِيْ اَهْلِكَ وَمالِكَ، اِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَاْلاَدَاءُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Abi Rabi'ah (RA) narrates: “The Prophet ﷺ borrowed forty thousand from me. Then, when wealth came to the Prophet ﷺ, he returned the loan to me and said: “May Allah Ta'ala grant barakah in your family and your wealth! The recompense for a loan is to return it and to praise (the lender) and thank him.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَوْ كَانَ لِيْ مِثْلُ اُحُدٍ ذَهَبًا مَا يَسُرُّنِيْ اَنْ لَا يَمُرَّ عَلَيَّ ثَلَاثٌ وَعِنْدِيْ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ اِلَّاشَيْءٌ اُرْصِدُهُ لِدَيْنٍ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “If I had gold equal to Mount Uhud, it would not please me that even a little of it should remain with me for three days, except a small amount needed to pay off a debt.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرِ النَّاسَ لَا يَشْكُرِ اللهَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ماجاء في الشكر ...رقم:١٩٥٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah Ta'ala either.”
